newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear confirms Shanghai Tyre talks.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear confirms Shanghai Tyre talks.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co Chief Executive Officer Samir Gibara confirmed Monday that Goodyear is one of several international companies involved in discussions with Shanghai Tyre & Rubber Co Ltd about possible purchase of a portion of the China tire firm.

"I'd be happy to confirm that we're talking to Shanghai Tyres," he said. "These are ongoing negotiations and the outcome of these negotiations is so undetermined at this point that it's not possible to make any significant comment."
Shanghai Tyre earlier declined comment on weekend reports that it may consider selling a portion of its state shares.
As reported earlier, a Shanghai Tyre spokesman said that all of its state shares were owned by Shanghai Chemical Industry Holding Co.
Gibara said Akron, Ohio-based Goodyear is one of several companies in discussions with the company.

"Goodyear and other companies are talking to Shanghai Tyres and have been talking and are still talking," he said. "(But) these things keep changing all the time so there is nothing really significant to report on that score."
